notes.title: Demo version 1.5 is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone and thank you for playing our game so far!

We got some feedbacks about bugs here and there.

The new version 1.5 fixes those issues and the game should work perfectly now!

Let us know if anything else goes wrong and we will do our best to fix it as soon as possible ;)

-- Kibou Entertainment team --

notes.title: Blood Opera Crescendo Demo available on Steam
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

Blood Opera Crescendo Demo is now available for download here!
Prepare yourself for a symphony of blood and classical music.

Also don't forget to support us on Kickstarter! 
The campaign has just begun!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bloodopera/blood-opera-crescendo

notes.title: Blood Opera Crescendo Kickstarter has started - Demo available!
notes.content:
It's a very important day for us: the Kickstarter campaign for Blood Opera Crescendo is live!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bloodopera/blood-opera-crescendo

It's also an interesting day for players as our demo is now available for download on the Kickstarter page!

Steam version of the demo is on its way and should be published the next days.

In the meantime we hope you will visit our Kickstarter campaign page, support us and leave a comment!

-- Kibou Entertainment Team --
